name: Reliance Industries Ltd
moat: Vertically integrated energy business funding fast-growing consumer and digital arms (Jio, Retail).

growthFactors.signal: Rising ARPU and 5G monetisation lift high-margin digital revenue.
New store additions and JioMart scale grow the consumer segment.
Strong GRMs / petchem spreads boost cash flows.
5G capex converting to enterprise & fixed-wireless revenue.
Green energy giga-factories add a long-term optionality leg.
Falling net debt improves financial flexibility.

negativeFactors.signal: Sharp fall in crude compresses O2C realisations.
Heavy new-energy and telecom capex can raise leverage.
Telecom tariff regulation or windfall taxes hit margins.
Miss on profit / EBITDA vs estimates.
Aggressive competitor pricing caps ARPU growth.
